name: edgex-go-transactional-command-publication
instr:
edgex-go cannot prepare security command effects without exposing them before commit. Add transactional execution for genPassword, getHttpStatus, help, listenTcp, gate, waitFor, and createToken, while preserving each Command's Execute output, blocking, status, and error behavior.

Every Command returns its status, error, and hidden Publication through ExecuteAtomic. Commit publishes each Artifact once. Abort publishes nothing and releases prepared resources. On partial commit failure, stop later artifacts and roll back. Keep the first operational failure primary in PublicationError and cleanup failures inspectable. Repeated finalization returns ErrPublicationFinalized with the exact text "publication already finalized".

OutputArtifact publishes complete buffered bytes. FileArtifact atomically replaces its destination. ListenerArtifact reserves its socket, accepts nothing before commit, activates on commit, and closes on abort.

genPassword stages one complete generated line. getHttpStatus completes its exchange but retains the status-code line. help stages the complete usage text from the existing callback. waitFor completes every configured dependency check, offers an empty publication, and leaves no worker after abort. gate waits for readiness, then publishes both listeners together; readiness failure releases both ports and remains primary. createToken preserves the prior credential until replacement commits and removes staging data on abort.

CommitResult makes both boot
